$comment: The shared animation set. Clips are authored once against sourceModel and retargeted onto every character at load time — that is what lets a model generated from a text prompt fight without anyone hand-animating it. Drop new GLB/FBX files in this folder and add an entry here.

$schema_notes.as: the name the engine looks up — see ClipAnimator's CLIP_CANDIDATES
$schema_notes.url: optional; defaults to sourceModel. Point it at any .glb or .fbx in this folder
$schema_notes.clip: the clip's name inside that file
$schema_notes.index: use instead of `clip` to take the Nth animation in the file
